// diagnostic

E1105

`#Layout(packed)` or `#Layout(align(N))` written on a struct.

What

`#Layout(packed)` or `#Layout(align(N))` written on a struct.

Why

The supported variants are `c` (C-compatible) and `columnar` (struct-of-arrays); `packed`/`align` are reserved for future milestones.

Fix

use `#Layout(c)` or `#Layout(columnar)`, or omit `#Layout` for the default.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1105: tests/ui/layout_unknown_variant.stderr.
